title: A clinical trial of raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd) in participants with ovarian cancer (MK-5909-006)
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label Study of Raludotatug Deruxtecan (MK-5909, R-DXd) Maintenance Treatment With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Newly-Diagnosed Advanced non–HRD-Positive Ovarian Cancer Following First-line Platinum-based Chemotherapy (ENGOT-ov102/MITO/GOG-3141/ REJOICE-Ovarian 04)
summary:
Main objective: 1. To compare raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd) maintenance treatment with or without bevacizumab to SoC with respect to PFS per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by blinded independent central review
2. To compare R-DXd maintenance treatment with or without bevacizumab to SoC with respect to OS

interventions.name: Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.
MVASI 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has a new, histologically confirmed diagnosis of International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) Stage III or Stage IV epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) (high-grade serous or high grade endometrioid), fallopian tube cancer, or primary peritoneal cancer
2. Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants must have well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy (ART)
3. Participants who are hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive are eligible if they have received hepatitis B virus (HBV) antiviral therapy for at least 4 weeks, and have undetectable HBV viral load prior to randomization
4. Participants with history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection are eligible if HCV viral load is undetectable
5. Has undergone primary debulking surgery (PDS) or interval debulking surgery (IDS)
6. Has completed a minimum of 4 cycles and a maximum of 6 cycles of first-line (1L) platinum-based chemotherapy
7. Has a response of complete response (CR), partial response (PR), stable disease (SD), or no evidence of disease (NED) by the physician investigator to 1L platinum based chemotherapy at the time of screening
8. Participants intended to receive bevacizumab as 1L maintenance treatment during the study must have received at least 2 cycles of bevacizumab 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks (q3w) or equivalent dose (with no dose reductions) in combination with the 1L platinum-based chemotherapy
9. According to the physician investigator’s assessment, poly-ADP ribose polymerase (PARP) inhibitor 1L maintenance treatment for non–homologous recombination deficiency (HRD)-positive disease is not the preferred option for the participant
10. Has provided non-irradiated tumor tissue for central determination of cadherin-6 (CDH6) and HRD status and biomarker research
11. Participants who have AEs due to previous anticancer therapies must have recovered to Grade ≤1 or baseline (except alopecia or vitiligo), as assessed by the physician investigator
12. Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 assessed within 7 days before randomization
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has non-serous or non-endometrioid high-grade epithelial histology, nonepithelial ovarian cancers (germ cell tumors and sex cord-stromal tumors), borderline tumors (low malignant potential), mucinous tumor, seromucinous tumor that is predominately mucinous, malignant Brenner’s tumor, and undifferentiated carcinoma
2. Has not recovered from AE associated with anticancer therapy before randomization
3. Has received prior radiotherapy within 2 weeks of start of study intervention, or has radiation-related toxicities, requiring corticosteroids
4. Has received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose of study intervention
5. Has intraperitoneal chemotherapy planned or has been administered as 1L therapy
6. Receives chronic steroid treatment (>10 mg prednisone [or equivalent] per day)
7. Has received 1L platinum-based chemotherapy without bevacizumab and have a response of SD or PR at the time of screening
8. Has an HRD-positive, unknown, or inconclusive status as determined by the central laboratory
9. Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years
10. Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
11. Has any history of interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis
12. Has had any of the following within 6 months before randomization: cerebrovascular accident, transient ischemic attack, or other arterial thromboembolic event (e.g. intestinal ischemia)
13. Has active infection requiring systemic therapy
14. Has not adequately recovered from major surgery or has ongoing surgical complications
15. Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication or previous history of inflammatory bowel disease (e.g. Crohn’s disease, ulcerative colitis, or chronic diarrhea)
16. Has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease
17. Has clinically severe pulmonary compromise resulting from intercurrent pulmonary illnesses
18. Has current, clinically relevant bowel obstruction (including subocclusive disease) including obstruction related to underlying epithelial EOC, abdominal fistula or GI perforation, intra-abdominal abscess, or evidence of rectosigmoid involvement by pelvic exam
19. Has a history of thrombotic disorders, hemorrhage, hemoptysis, or active GI bleeding within 6 months before randomization
20. HIV-infected participants with a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or multicentric Castleman disease
21. Participants who discontinued bevacizumab during 1L platinum-based chemotherapy due to any AE related to bevacizumab are not eligible to receive bevacizumab
